name: Spirit Totem
label: Quest
description: Spirit Totem: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The elemental spirits of this place don't be likin' me any more.
You know about the totems more than any, and I be needin' a spirit totem to protect me. We already got the elements, now we need somethin' more with more nature. More primal.
In the Western Plaguelands you can kill bears for claws and spiders for their eyes. The carrion birds eat everything, so they might have either one.

clips.title: Progress
paras: The spirits know what we're up to, and they been tryin' to kill me! I hope you got the parts.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Great, mon! Let's try it out....
